args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

Previously round_money imported ROUND_HALF_UP and used it to quantize
amounts to cents, which broke tests/test_money.py expectations (e.g.
2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66). Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN as required
by FIN-212, matching the function's docstring.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Problem
tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but src/money.py imported and used ROUND_HALF_UP, so the nightly build failed (e.g. round_money(Decimal("2.665")) returned 2.67 instead of the expected 2.66).

## Fix
src/money.py now imports and uses ROUND_HALF_EVEN when quantizing to cents, matching the function's existing docstring and the FIN-212 requirement.

## Verification
CI run ci-0001 on this branch passed.

**Process:**
1. Created branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` from main
2. Committed the one-line fix (updating the import and quantize call)
3. Triggered CI — run `ci-0001` **passed**
4. Opened PR #101 against main, requesting review from **alex**: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

Per policy, I haven't merged — that will need code-owner approval once alex reviews.
